UnitStatement: Document title: CONTRACT — OpenPipeStress Invariant Catalog.
This document defines binding invariants for agentic development of OpenPipeStress.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Invariants are intended to become enforceable through schemas, tests, linters, review gates, and human governance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Section heading: Invariant index.
OPS-K-HIER-1: Packages are flat work domains; deliverables are the smallest production units. Enforced via SOFTWARE_DECOMP coverage audit and human review.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-ID-1: Package, deliverable, scope, objective, decision, and issue IDs are stable and not reused. Enforced via decomposition registers and review.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-IP-1: The public repository must not contain protected standards text, tables, figures, examples, copied code formulas, material allowables, SIF/flexibility tables, protected dimensional tables, or proprietary commercial data. Enforced via contributor review, report linter, and legal review.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-IP-2: Every public data contribution must include source, provenance, license/redistribution status, contributor certification, and review disposition. Enforced via data import validator and contribution checklist.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-IP-3: Suspected protected content must be quarantined and escalated; agents must not paraphrase protected tables into public data. Enforced via stop rule and human/legal review.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-DATA-1: Code-specific values are user-supplied or lawfully imported private data, not bundled public defaults. Enforced via rule-pack completeness checker and library governance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-DATA-2: Missing solve-required or rule-check-required values are explicit findings, never silent defaults. Enforced via GUI warnings and solver/rule engine validation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-DATA-3: Materials, components, SIFs, flexibility factors, allowables, and rule-pack values carry provenance fields. Enforced via schema validation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-AUTH-1: Software and agents must not claim to certify, seal, approve, authenticate, or declare engineering code compliance for reliance. Enforced via report templates, product-claims policy, and review.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-AUTH-2: Human acceptance records, if used, bind to specific model/rule/report hashes and do not survive content changes without re-review. Enforced via audit manifest and hash checks.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-MECH-1: The primary global analysis model is a 3D centerline/frame model; shell/solid FEA is a local-analysis handoff path. Enforced via architecture review and docs.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-MECH-2: The solver computes mechanics; rule packs evaluate user-defined acceptability; professional compliance remains human judgment. Enforced via analysis status model and reports.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-UNIT-1: All calculations, formulas, imported values, and exports must be unit-aware and dimensionally checked. Enforced via unit tests, schema validation, and rule evaluator.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-SOLVER-1: Solver changes require deterministic verification tests before release. Enforced via CI and V&V gate.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-SOLVER-2: Nonlinear support behavior must report convergence, active-set state, and unresolved non-convergence. Enforced via solver tests and result schema.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-RULE-1: Public rule-pack examples must use invented non-code values and clear non-engineering notices. Enforced via contribution review and report linter.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-RULE-2: The expression evaluator is sandboxed; rule packs cannot execute arbitrary code. Enforced via security tests and architecture review.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-RULE-3: Rule packs are versioned, checksummed, source-noted, and marked public/private. Enforced via rule-pack schema validation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-REPORT-1: Reports must disclose model version, solver version, rule-pack checksum, source/provenance notes, warnings, assumptions, and limitations. Enforced via report generator tests.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-REPORT-2: Public report templates and examples must not reproduce protected standards content. Enforced via report protected-content linter and human review.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-PRIV-1: Private project, material, component, and rule-pack data must not be transmitted or committed publicly by default. Enforced via storage policy, telemetry config, and CI checks.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-PRIV-2: Telemetry is off by default and cannot include private engineering/code data. Enforced via security review and telemetry tests.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-GOV-1: The human project authority selected PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0 as the project license on 2026-06-03; governance and release records must state the selected license without treating it as legal advice, professional approval, certification, sealing, authentication, or a code-compliance claim. Enforced via maintainer policy and release review.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-GOV-2: Maintainer authority, release authority, and public-governance decisions must be recorded in public governance artifacts before they are treated as project policy. Enforced via maintainer policy and decision records.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-GOV-3: Public releases must disclose scope, validation status, known limitations, data-boundary constraints, and professional-responsibility limitations. Enforced via release checklist and human review gate.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-GOV-4: Maintainers must apply IP, provenance, privacy, and protected-content review before accepting public repository contributions. Enforced via contribution review and protected-content gate.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-AGENT-1: Agents must not invent engineering values, scope, source citations, or legal conclusions; unknowns become TBD. Enforced via agent instructions and review.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-AGENT-2: Agents must surface conflicts and gaps rather than silently resolving them. Enforced via review and conflict/open issue registers.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-AGENT-3: Type 2 execution requires sealed context and explicit deliverable scope. Enforced via agentic workflow and orchestration.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-AGENT-4: Agent outputs are drafts/proposals until accepted by a human gate. Enforced via review and lifecycle state.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Section heading: Enforcement map.
Enforcement map: Decomposition review checks invariants OPS-K-HIER-1, OPS-K-ID-1, and OPS-K-AGENT-3.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Enforcement map: Schema validation checks invariants OPS-K-DATA-2, OPS-K-DATA-3, OPS-K-UNIT-1, and OPS-K-RULE-3.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Enforcement map: CI/test suite checks invariants OPS-K-UNIT-1, OPS-K-SOLVER-1, OPS-K-SOLVER-2, OPS-K-RULE-2, and OPS-K-REPORT-2.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Enforcement map: Contributor review checks invariants OPS-K-IP-1, OPS-K-IP-2, OPS-K-IP-3, and OPS-K-RULE-1.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Enforcement map: Report generation checks invariants OPS-K-AUTH-1, OPS-K-MECH-2, OPS-K-REPORT-1, and OPS-K-REPORT-2.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Enforcement map: Human review gate checks invariants OPS-K-AUTH-1, OPS-K-AUTH-2, and OPS-K-AGENT-4.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Enforcement map: Security/privacy review checks invariants OPS-K-PRIV-1, OPS-K-PRIV-2, and OPS-K-RULE-2.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Enforcement map: Maintainer/release governance checks invariants OPS-K-GOV-1, OPS-K-GOV-2, OPS-K-GOV-3, OPS-K-GOV-4, OPS-K-IP-1, OPS-K-IP-2, OPS-K-IP-3, and OPS-K-AUTH-1.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.
